description: Soy estudiante de preparatoria apasionada por la ciencia, la tecnología, la robótica y la exploración espacial. Actualmente desarrollo NEREUS SPACE, un proyecto de monitoreo oceánico que integra sensores, Arduino, ESP32 y una plataforma web para visualizar datos ambientales relacionados con la formación e intensidad de los huracanes. Me interesa aprender, innovar y compartir conocimientos en áreas como programación, electrónica, meteorología y ciencias de la Tierra.
summary:
Nereus Space is an ocean monitoring prototype developed using Arduino technology, designed to measure environmental variables such as sea temperature and atmospheric pressure. Its planned implementation site is Puerto Vicente Guerrero, in the municipality of Tecpan de Galeana, Guerrero, a coastal area vulnerable to extreme weather events.

The project aims to contribute to risk prevention through the collection and monitoring of environmental data that can help identify conditions associated with the formation and intensification of hurricanes. Through electronic sensors and a real-time data visualization system, Nereus Space seeks to facilitate the observation of changes in the ocean environment and generate useful information to strengthen early warning systems.

This project addresses the challenge of using technology and innovation to tackle environmental and social problems, especially in coastal communities exposed to natural disasters such as Hurricane Otis. Its importance lies in its goal of transforming scientific data into preventive tools, improving emergency response capabilities, and promoting a culture of civil protection. Nereus Space represents a technological proposal with a social impact, whose main purpose is to contribute to the protection of marine ecosystems and, above all, human lives.
details:
Project Details – Nereus Space

Nereus Space is an Arduino-based ocean monitoring prototype designed to collect and display environmental data, focusing on sea temperature and atmospheric pressure. It works through electronic sensors connected to a microcontroller that processes the measurements and displays the information in real time. This allows users to observe environmental variations and better understand ocean conditions.

The project offers a technological approach to environmental monitoring and disaster risk prevention. By collecting relevant data, it aims to contribute to identifying environmental changes that may be associated with conditions favorable to hurricane development and intensification. Its intended impact is to support early warning efforts, strengthen preparedness in coastal communities, and help protect human lives and marine ecosystems.

The prototype was developed using Arduino technology, electronic sensors, a breadboard, connecting wires, an LCD display, LEDs, and a buzzer for visual and sound alerts. The programming was carried out using the Arduino IDE and the C/C++ programming language. These components work together to collect, process, and communicate environmental information.

The creativity of Nereus Space lies in combining accessible technology with a real environmental and social challenge. Rather than simply measuring ocean conditions, the project seeks to transform environmental data into useful information for prevention and awareness.

During its development, the team considered the vulnerability of coastal communities in Guerrero, the importance of reliable measurements, the accessibility of materials, the functionality of the electronic system, and the potential for future improvements. Nereus Space is designed as a scalable prototype that could eventually incorporate additional sensors and communication systems to expand its monitoring capabilities.
